summary.business_type: Fine Dining Restaurant & Seasonal Hearth Gastronomy (Local Business / Colombo, Sri Lanka)
top_findings: Native Next.js 16.4.3 App Router with Server-Side Rendering and fast pre-rendered static routes
Dynamic robots.txt automatically disallows administrative and API paths while allowing search bots
Complete Schema.org Restaurant JSON-LD structured data with opening hours, menu link, cuisine, and geo-coordinates
Valid sitemap.xml route covering all key user anchor journeys (Homepage, Menu, Reservations, Location)
Strict semantic heading hierarchy (Single H1 'Artisanal Dining', H2 for menu categories, H3 for dishes)
quick_wins: Ensure production domain environment variable NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_URL is set in hosting provider
Set up Google Search Console property and submit sitemap.xml
Claim and verify Google Business Profile (GBP) matching the 142 Galle Road NAP data exactly

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Dynamic robots.txt prevents indexing of /admin and /api endpoints
Sitemap.xml dynamically serves valid URLs with weekly/monthly change frequencies
Valid HTML5 semantic tags (<header>, <nav>, <main>, <section>, <footer>)
Zero broken links across internal anchors (#top, #menu, #reservation, #contact)

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Rich, artisanal culinary storytelling with E-E-A-T signals
High readability with human editorial tone
Zero duplicate content or thin pages

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Descriptive, keyword-rich title tag under 60 characters
High-converting meta description with clear CTA under 160 characters
Single, clear <h1> element on page with logical <h2> and <h3> hierarchy
Full OpenGraph metadata for rich social and messaging previews

categories.name: Schema & Structured Data
what_works: Full Schema.org 'Restaurant' JSON-LD embedded in layout
PostalAddress schema localized to Colombo 03, Sri Lanka
GeoCoordinates (latitude/longitude) for local map targeting
OpeningHoursSpecification accurately detailing dinner and lunch schedules
acceptsReservations enabled with direct menu link

categories.name: Performance (CWV)

Google Fonts preconnected with display=swap
Lenis smooth scroll with layout stability (CLS < 0.05)

categories.name: AI Search Readiness (GEO)

On-site AI Concierge (Remy) answering guest queries with official restaurant context
Clear table schedule and pricing signals

categories.name: Images
what_works: Descriptive alt text on all culinary and dining room photography
Aspect-ratio and responsive object-cover styling preventing layout shift
